task.title: Install Software Updates
task.shortdesc: Install software updates on your computer, phone, and browser.

taskbody.context: Install updates once you see a notification on your computer, phone, or web browser. On university-owned computers, your local IT staff may install some updates for you, but you may still need to restart your computer to finish them.

step.cmd: Open the update settings of the device you are using.
step.info: To find them on your device, see Where to find updates.

step.cmd: Check if there are any available updates.
Install any available updates that were found.

image.alt: Windows Update settings page with the Install all button.

step.cmd: Restart your device if asked to do so.
step.info: If there are issues with an update on a university computer, contact your local IT support.

taskbody.result: Your device has been updated with the most recent security fixes.
